training_data: ADNI 2 peripheral-blood microarray plus MoCA (51 pMCI / 29 sMCI); bootstrap internal validation
test_data: ADNI GO (31 pMCI / 30 sMCI), another phase of the same ADNI study
reason: The nomogram (MoCA, EBF1, age, sex) was built on ADNI 2 and applied to ADNI GO (C-index 0.751), which the authors call external validation. ADNI GO is another phase of the same ADNI consortium, sites and protocol, a case the audit explicitly excludes from V4. It is a held-out partition, so V3 stands.

quotes.quote: These patients were included in two cohort studies, ADNI 2 and ADNI GO, with the follow-up period ranging from 6 to 72 months.

In our study, the ADNI 2 dataset (51 cases of pMCI and 29 cases of sMCI) was used for the identification of feature genes, the development of a nomogram prognostic model, and internal validation, whereas the ADNI GO dataset (31 cases of pMCI and 30 cases of sMCI) was used for external validation.
In the external validation set, the C-index was 0.751.
